text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, Nakayama Racecourse was 
resounding with raw heat, cheers, and 
roaring support!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the pack! They come storming into 
the final straight—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Victoire Pisa!" "Hang in 
there, keep pushing...!" "Go! Run, Pisa!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (...Everyone...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Their warm cheers... Strength is welling 
up――from deep inside!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was as if light had burst forth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone patted each other on the back and 
shared in the joy. Transcending all 
boundaries, she was showered with 
blessings.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: This is—

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, hahaha! It's a full-on festival, 
just like back then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... It has returned to life.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A weaver of hope—is that what I am?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...What an incredible sight. To create 
such a profound sense of unity."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What unbelievable volume. It's so loud, 
honestly... *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Victoire Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I managed... to run...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...My body still feels a bit heavy. My 
breathing was really agonizing, too.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (But—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Me—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for wishing for me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if welcoming her, thunderous applause 
echoed throughout the entire racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This warm circle of support has given me 
new hope...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay here too. With everyone... 
forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Such a pure—brand-new hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us grow even greater together. Let us 
expand, ever stronger and wider.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And— let us reach out our hands to those 
who tremble.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Just like everyone did for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous cheer erupted once again. 
There lay a great circle of hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
High in the sky, the distant sound of 
fireworks felt like it reached my ears—
